question: Whose autobiography is the book 'By God's Decree'?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Kapil Dev.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev** is a former Indian cricketer.
 
• Nickname: **The Haryana Hurricane**.
 
• He is one of the greatest all-rounders in Indian cricket.
 
• He led the **Indian cricket team that won the 1983 Cricket World Cup.**
 
• He is the first player to take 200 One Day International wickets.
 
• He joined the Indian Territorial Army as a** Lieutenant Colonel** in 2008.
 
• **Notable works:**
 
 
• ***By God's Decree.***
 
• *Cricket My Style.*
 
• ***Straight from the Heart**.*
 
• *We, The Sikhs.*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ***

 
• **Alyque Padamsee **is also known as the** Father of modern Indian advertising.**

 
 
• He created iconic ads such as** Liril girl, Hamara Bajaj, and Surf's Lalitaji.**
 
• He is famous for playing Mohammad Ali Jinnah in **the film Gandhi (1982 Biopic).**
 
 
 
• **Raj Kapoor** was an Indian actor and producer in Hindi cinema. 
 
 
• He was the son of well-known Indian actor **Prithviraj Kapoor.**
 
 
 
• **Mohinder Amarnath** was the Man of the Match in the **semifinal against England and in the final against the West Indies.**
 
 
• **In the finals**, Mohinder Amarnath (**46 from 92 balls, 4 fours, 1 six**) picked up the **man-of-the-match** **award **for his all-around performance, which includes **3 wickets.​**
